core_obligations: Limits commute: the limit of the fibre products is the fibre product with the limit (limits commute with base change in the category of schemes with affine transitions).
Affine transition composition: the transition morphisms of the approximating system are affine; their compositions stay affine, giving the directed system structure.
proof_roadmap: Fibre products commute with the limit.
Affineness of transitions; conclude the approximation statement.
difficulty_reason: Limits commute with fibre products + affine transition composition: two mechanisms, cleanly composed.

compared.difference: The sibling builds the cofinal approximating system (delivered as L30215); this lemma is the relative approximation statement for finite type morphisms. Different statements.
